papers.title: Altitude-induced hypoxia suppresses Varroa mite reproduction in Tibetan honey bees
papers.abstract: Our reliance on honey bees ( Apis mellifera ) for pollination services and honey production continues to increase due to the global decline in other pollinators and rising demand for honey. The ectoparasitic mite ( Varroa destructor ) remains the biggest pest of honey bees forcing beekeepers into continual miticide use. Beekeepers on the Tibetan Plateau, however, report rarely seeing mites in their colonies, unlike all other areas of China. We conducted a series of translocation experiments to investigate this phenomenon. Here, we show that hypoxic conditions above 3,500 m on the Tibetan Plateau reduce mite fecundity and arrest offspring development, and so prevent the long-term persistence of the mite population. This reduced mite fertility and arrested offspring development were also found in honey bee colonies maintained at low altitude but under hypoxic conditions like those found at 3,500 m. This discovery of a physiological limit to V. destructor reproduction highlights a previously unrecognized sensitivity of this mite to reduced oxygen availability, the mechanistic basis of which warrants further investigation. This discovery could unlock new chemical-free innovative mite-control methods that will benefit both the beekeeping industry and help ensure food security.
papers.titleZh: 高海拔缺氧抑制瓦蟎在西藏蜜蜂中的繁殖
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊針對西藏高原養蜂戶鮮少見到瓦蟎的現象進行移地實驗。結果顯示，海拔超過3,500公尺的缺氧環境會降低瓦蟎的繁殖力並阻斷後代發育，因而阻止蟎群長期存續。將蜜蜂群體置於低海拔但模擬3,500公尺缺氧條件下，也觀察到相同的降低繁殖力與後代發育停滯現象。研究指出瓦蟎對低氧環境存在生理限制，這是先前未被認識的敏感性。作者認為此發現可能為開發無化學藥劑的蟎害控制方法提供方向，有助養蜂業與糧食安全。

papers.title: Agentic Discovery Transfer Enables Cross-Cancer Discovery at Scale
papers.abstract: Cancer research generates tens of thousands of studies each year, yet whether a published finding holds in another cancer type or patient population is rarely tested as doing so is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We define this task as discovery transfer and present SMART, a multi-agent large language model framework for discovery transfer in single-cell RNA-sequencing studies. Given a source manuscript and a target dataset, SMART extracts major clinical and mechanistic findings, generates and executes analyses for the testable findings, reports which findings transfer, and suggests follow-up. Applied to 121 studies across six cancer types, SMART identified findings that transfer across cancers, including a lung cancer prognostic signature that we confirmed to be associated with survival in liver cancer, pancreatic cancer and pleural mesothelioma. SMART also generated new mechanistic hypotheses, demonstrating how agentic discovery transfer can extend published findings beyond their original setting.
papers.titleZh: 代理式發現轉移實現跨癌症大規模發現
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出 SMART，一個用於單細胞 RNA 定序研究的多智能體大型語言模型框架，處理所謂的發現轉移任務。給定來源手稿與目標資料集，SMART 會萃取主要臨床與機制性發現、為可檢驗的發現產生並執行分析、報告哪些發現可轉移並提出後續建議。該框架應用於六種癌症類型的 121 個研究，辨識出跨癌症轉移的發現，其中包括一個肺癌預後特徵，該特徵被確認與肝癌、胰臟癌及胸膜間皮瘤的存活相關。研究也指出 SMART 能產生新的機制性假說，顯示代理式發現轉移可將已發表結果延伸至原始情境之外。

papers.title: Where single-cell foundation models help: a public-data benchmark of annotation, in silico perturbation and gene regulatory inference
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models (FMs) are proposed as general tools for cell-type annotation, in silico perturbation and gene-regulatory-network (GRN) inference. To identify where they add value, we benchmarked five FMs (scGPT, Geneformer V1 and V2, Nicheformer, scFoundation), CellOracle, supervised perturbation models including STATE, and task-matched simple baselines on the same public data, from K562 Perturb-seq screens and primary cells to a brain organoid CRISPR screen, an in vivo Perturb-seq screen of the developing mouse cortex and lung cancer biopsies, using each model with its recommended settings and with tuned fine-tuning, under an analysis plan fixed before the new results. FMs were most useful when labels had to be transferred across species: from human to mouse lung, Nicheformer reached 0.98 accuracy with cosine kNN, above every baseline including CellTypist with tuned regularisation (0.94), and fine-tuned Geneformer V2 transferred labels from mouse to human with macro-F1 0.88, against at most 0.74 for baselines trained on the same cells. In K562, zero-shot perturbations captured the direction of real responses, with up to 76% of perturbations shifted in the expected direction (Geneformer V2, p < 1e-8), and with its native overexpression protocol Geneformer V2 tracked CRISPRa effect sizes ({rho} = 0.30, q = 0.001). Geneformer V2 networks recovered patient-level tumour differential expression better than co-expression (fold enrichment 2.9 versus 2.0, on five hubs). Within a species, FM embeddings did not exceed principal components: on 28,344 organoid screen cells the best FM reached macro-F1 0.78 zero-shot and 0.84 after fine-tuning, against 0.89 for principal components with kNN. In silico knockouts in the organoid screen and in the mouse cortex followed the expression of the target, moved embeddings no more than deletions of expression-matched control genes and met the predefined criterion in none of 46 tests, in which naive predictors such as the number of perturbed cells did as well. Fine-tuning changed classification accuracy and the size of predicted effects but not their ranking, gene networks or the advantage of a training-mean baseline. We release the benchmark, baselines and pipeline checks as the fmaudit package, so that new models can be evaluated on the tasks where FMs already help.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞基礎模型在細胞註關注、電腦模擬擾動與基因調控推論中的應用價值基準測試
papers.summaryZh: 本研究針對單細胞基礎模型（FMs）在細胞型態註關注、電腦模擬擾動與基因調控網路推論的實際效益進行了公開資料基準測試。結果顯示，這些模型在跨物種標籤轉移時表現最佳，例如 Nicheformer 與微調後的 Geneformer V2 在跨物種標籤轉移上超越了基準模型。在 K562 細胞中，零發揮（zero-shot）擾動捕捉到了真實反應的方向，且 Geneformer V2 網路恢復了患者層級的腫瘤差異表現。然而，在同物種內，基礎模型的嵌入表現並未超越主成分分析（principal components），且在多項測試中，電腦模擬基因剔除未能達到預定義的標準。

papers.title: A CITE-seq atlas of mouse embryonic hematopoiesis maps endothelial heterogeneity and reveals emerging HSC-associated states
papers.abstract: The emergence of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) from hemogenic endothelium during embryonic development is a tightly regulated process in which only a restricted population acquires molecular features associated with long-term hematopoietic potential. Although endothelial-to-hematopoietic transition (EHT) has been extensively characterized, the transcriptional and phenotypic heterogeneity accompanying the emergence of HSC-associated states remains incompletely understood. Here, we generated an integrated single-cell transcriptomic and surface-protein atlas of mouse embryonic hematopoiesis using CITE-seq across E9.5, E10.25 and E11.5 aorta-gonad-mesonephros (AGM) regions and E11.5 foetal liver. Analysis of lineage-associated transcriptional programmes distinguished arterial, venous, hemogenic and HSC-associated states, with HSC-associated signatures occupying a more restricted distribution than broader hematopoietic specification programmes. Hlf expression closely corresponded with HSC-associated transcriptional signatures and CD27 surface-protein abundance, identifying a potentially useful immunophenotypic feature for prospective enrichment of HSC-associated populations. Graph-based connectivity, diffusion pseudotime and RNA velocity analyses revealed heterogeneous relationships among endothelial and hemogenic populations, suggesting an inferred progression from arterial preHSC-HE through arterial HSC-HE towards more advanced HSC-associated states. Notably, analysis of E9.5 endothelial cells identified a restricted subset exhibiting elevated RNA velocity-derived connectivity towards arterial preHSC-HE. These cells displayed distinct transcriptional features with enrichment of pathways associated with cell adhesion, junctional organization and signalling. Differences in selected surface proteins further distinguished endothelial cells with high and low predicted connectivity. In parallel, analysis of arterial hemogenic populations revealed changes in transcriptional programmes and surface-protein expression along inferred developmental trajectories, highlighting coordinated molecular and immunophenotypic remodeling during HSC-associated development. Together, these findings provide a multimodal framework for resolving endothelial heterogeneity and identifying candidate cellular states associated with early HSC emergence. By linking transcriptional signatures to measurable surface phenotypes, this atlas offers experimentally testable strategies for investigating the developmental conditions that precede HSC-associated identity, while distinguishing computationally inferred trajectories from functionally established HSC fate.
papers.titleZh: CITE-seq 圖譜描繪小鼠胚胎造血內皮異質性並揭示新興 HSC 相關狀態
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊以 CITE-seq 建立小鼠胚胎造血的單細胞轉錄組與表面蛋白整合圖譜，涵蓋 E9.5、E10.25 與 E11.5 的主動脈-生殖腺-中腎區以及 E11.5 胎肝。分析區分出動脈、靜脈、造血內皮與 HSC 相關狀態，HSC 相關特徵的分布比較廣泛的造血特化程式更為受限。Hlf 的表現與 HSC 相關轉錄特徵及 CD27 表面蛋白豐度密切對應，被指出為富集 HSC 相關族群的潛在免疫表型特徵。基於圖形連通性、擴散偽時間與 RNA velocity 的分析顯示內皮與造血內皮族群間關係異質，推測從動脈 preHSC-HE 經由動脈 HSC-HE 朝向更進階的 HSC 相關狀態發展。E9.5 內皮細胞中發現一受限亞群對動脈 preHSC-HE 呈現較高的 RNA velocity 推導連通性，該細胞具有不同的轉錄特徵，並富集與細胞黏附、連接組織與訊號相關的途徑。高低預測連通性的內皮細胞在選定表面蛋白上亦有差異。

papers.title: Disturbance increases soil microbiome functional redundancy but decreases capacity for insurance via winnowed environmental responsiveness
papers.abstract: More redundancy doesn’t always mean more resilience. Here, the authors use seven-year-long metagenomics data from soils above Centralia’s coal seam fire to show that heat disturbance increases microbial functional redundancy but narrows environmental responsiveness, potentially lowering insurance against future stress.
papers.titleZh: 擾動提升土壤微生物功能冗餘卻削弱環境應變保險能力
papers.summaryZh: 本研究利用長達七年的土壤宏基因組數據，分析位於Centralia煤層火災上方的土壤微生物群落。結果顯示，熱擾動使微生物的功能冗餘增加，但同時縮窄了環境反應性。作者指出，功能冗餘上升並不必然代表韌性提升。研究認為此種環境反應性的削減可能降低微生物群落對未來壓力的保險能力。

papers.title: In vivo programming of dual-targeted CAR-T cells facilitates vascular disruption and T-cell infiltration in solid tumors
papers.abstract: Li and colleagues introduce an mRNA lipid nanoparticle platform for the selective transfection of endogenous T cells within the spleen; by dual-targeted CAR T cell in vivo programming, the authors show that VEGFR2 CAR-T cells disrupt the tumor vasculature, favoring the infiltration and activity of tumor-directed CAR-T cells.
papers.titleZh: 體內編程雙靶點 CAR-T 細胞促進腫瘤血管破壞與 T 細胞浸潤
papers.summaryZh: Li 等人提出一種 mRNA 脂質奈米粒子平台，可選擇性轉染脾臟內的內源性 T 細胞。研究利用體內編程的雙靶點 CAR-T 策略進行評估。結果顯示，VEGFR2 CAR-T 細胞可破壞腫瘤血管。血管破壞有助於腫瘤定向 CAR-T 細胞的浸潤與活性。此方法提供體內生成 CAR-T 的途徑，並將血管干預與腫瘤靶向結合。

Bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes as saturated bioisosteres of meta-benzene
paper.abstract: The authors synthesize bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes and provide support for their ability to mimic meta-substituted benzenes in biological contexts.

paper.title: Automated data to model transformation for constraint programming with AI
paper.abstract: The authors introduce CPAM-LLM, a framework that converts unstructured optimization problems into executable constraint models using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, data augmentation, and dynamic constraints.

paper.title: Modulating FCC/HCP phase boundaries in inverse Co@BOx catalysts via crystal-phase-ratio variation for propane oxidative dehydrogenation
paper.abstract: Oxidative dehydrogenation of propane (ODHP) offers a promising route to propylene, but developing catalysts that operate efficiently at low temperatures while maintaining high activity and selectivity remains a formidable challenge. Here, the authors report a Co@BOx inverse catalyst in which phase boundaries within the subsurface cobalt promoter enable efficient low-temperature ODHP.

paper.title: Atomically ordered few-layer molybdenum boride MBenes for enhanced electromagnetic response
paper.abstract: The authors develop a theory-guided molten-salt route that selectively removes aluminum to produce atomically ordered, few-layer MoB MBenes with few Mo vacancies. The preserved Mo−B framework enhances polarization and electromagnetic response.

paper.title: Asymmetric coordination triggers dual-site synergy in gold nanoclusters for efficient aerobic oxidation
paper.abstract: The construction of atomically precise heterogeneous catalysts that integrate multiple distinct active sites into a synergistic architecture is highly attractive but challenging. Here, we report an Au39 nanocluster with heteroatoms introduced to modulate the local coordination environment and construct asymmetric coordination units on the surface.

paper.title: Hybrid-parity sliding multiferroics
paper.abstract: Sliding multiferroicity allows electrical control of magnetism. Here, the authors uncover a sliding multiferroicity in unconventional magnet with hybrid-parity spin splitting, enabling ferroelectric switching of even and odd parity spin splittings, both of which are manifested in spin currents.
